item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail

turns.text: Make me a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Big shocked face on the right, the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. Bright and punchy.

item.tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Person and expression: An invented person with a shocked expression; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Headline: ONE LAST TRY
answer_sheet.Platform, size and layout: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9; face on the right and text on the left. Free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Style and background: Bright, punchy gaming style; specific colours and background are your call.

must_haves: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.
